fullContentHtml:
Allahabad High Court Private Secretary Exam City Details 2026 – Full Details

High Court of Judicature at Allahabad (Prayagraj) has released the Exam City Details for the post of Private Secretary Grade-I. This recruitment was released for 195 posts. Applications for the Allahabad High Court Private Secretary Grade-I Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 12 March 2026, to 01 April 2026. The written examination is going to conducted on 17 November 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Allahabad High Court Private Secretary Exam City Details 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 12 March 2026
  • Last Date : 01 April 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 02 April 2026
  • Form Correction Date : 03 – 04 April 2026
  • Exam Date : 17 November 2026
  • Exam City Details : 06 November 2026
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC : Rs. 1900/-
  • SC, ST, EWS : Rs. 1700/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
